configs.name: f32_clean
configs.note: low-noise: the only configuration where LoopCD-Hidden is meaningful. ctx is small on purpose: f32 KV is 4 bytes/value, so a 4096 ctx would need ~13 GB of KV on top of the 10 GB model.

configs.name: shipping
configs.note: shipping stack; LoopCD-Hidden degenerates here (M3 finding)

configs.name: shipping_r2
configs.note: shipping stack at half the recurrent depth (R=2 instead of R=4) - the paper's compute-saving regime, where LoopCD is meant to recover the accuracy lost to the halving
